cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six losses! Keep every score sheet; I'll decide which one opens our comeback documentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The tournament is over. Shall I pack the shirts away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may label the box 'before the comeback.' Next season's opening shot will need those shirts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There isn't a next season for us. The team is disbanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take everyone's address before you close the box. I'll call them for the reunion. A team that has to find each other again before it wins gives us a much better ending.
